                                                                                                                                                       development of the trenchless project, including engineer-          microtunneling qualifications should hire qualified staff or
                                                                                                                                                       ing, drawings, specifications, submittal requirements, and          a microtunneling subconsultant knowledgeable in the field.
                                                                                                                                                       work plans. Each project has its own set of unique chal-            The contractor and its key personnel should be prequalified

                                                                                                                                                       not be applicable to all projects. The engineer should use          project. More details on suggested contractor qualifications
                                                                                                                                                       a standard of care and good judgment in selecting which             are discussed in Sections 15.4 and 21.2.

                                                                                                                                                     A milestone in the acceptance of microtunneling occurred in       microtunneling is now used in full face rock as well as with

                                                                                                                                                  As a starting point, the contract documents should establish          14.5   THRUST BLOCKS
                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Thrust blocks are designed to distribute loads into the ground in
                                                                                                                                                                                                                        a uniform manner so that any deflection of the thrust block is
                                                                                                                                                                                                                        uniform and does not impart excessive loads to the shaft itself
                                                                                                                                                                                                                        or cause the jacking frame to become misaligned. If the jacking
                                                                                                                                                                                                                        frame becomes misaligned, the pipe can be point loaded, leading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                        to pipe failure in some cases. If the jacking shaft is expected
                                                                                                                                                                                                                        to be located in ground unable to support the maximum antici-
                                                                                                                                                                                                                        pated jacking force with an appropriate factor of safety, then
                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ground improvement or other measures should be considered
                                                                                                                                                                                                                        during the design phase and should be included in the contract
                                                                                                                                                                                                                        documents.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Commentary. Thrust blocks are constructed between the jacking
                                                                                                                                                                                                                        frame and the wall of the jacking shaft to provide a mechanism
                                                                                                                                                                                                                        for transferring jacking loads into the ground. Detailed design
                                                                                                                                                                                                                        of thrust walls, including establishment of allowable thrust load,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                        is typically the responsibility of the contractor, subject to perfor-
                                                                                                                                                                                                                        mance requirements established by the engineer.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                           Guidance for the design of thrust blocks can be found in the
                                                                                                                                                                                                                        following references:

                                                                                                                                                  manhole is typically considered incidental to the bid item.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Demobilization expenses should include removal of equipment,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                        transportation costs of equipment off site, decommissioning of
                                                                                                                                                  27.6   RESCUE SHAFTS
                                                                                                                                                                                                                        temporary facilities, and cleaning of worksites.
                                                                                                                                                  Provisions should be established in the contract to cover the cost
                                                                                                                                                  and time associated with rescue shafts. A rescue shaft may be         Commentary. A separate bid item for demobilization should be
                                                                                                                                                  needed for obstruction removal, differing site conditions, equip-     considered because the worksites must be returned to an accept-
                                                                                                                                                  ment failure, or excessive deviation from the design line and         able condition, and final payment must be made to the
                                                                                                                                                  grade. The need and value of a rescue shaft allowance should be       contractor.
                                                                                                                                                  defined on the basis of anticipated site and ground conditions.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                        27.10   DIFFERING SITE CONDITIONS
                                                                                                                                                  Commentary. Rescue shafts can be paid for as time and materi-
                                                                                                                                                  als under a fixed price allowance for all bidders. The amount of      If site conditions are different from those described in the con-

                                                                                                                                                  the location and level of effort required to build a rescue shaft     conditions adversely affected the work, the contractor is entitled
                                                                                                                                                  are unknown. An allowance item paid for by time and materials         to some form of compensation. See Section 15.8.
                                                                                                                                                  apportions risk fairly. Compensation for a rescue shaft should be
                                                                                                                                                  based on the evaluation of cause. Compensation should include         Commentary. None.
